text:
maya: Heads-up — builds started failing on the container push stage after the creds rotation earlier this morning. CI job log shows 401 from our registry.

maya: paste of the snippet:
```
Step 15/16 : PUSH image -> registry.redwood-inference.internal/reports/service:staging-2026-03-17
Error: failed to push image: unauthorized: authentication required
response from registry: {"errors":[{"code":"UNAUTHORIZED","message":"authentication required"}]}
```

maya: @alex any chance the CI secret didn't get updated? :thinking_face:

alex: I saw the creds rotation run via ops this morning. They updated the k8s secret in prod but I didn't see the CI pipeline secret update. Will check the secrets manager right now.

sam: quick check — is this only pushing to the internal registry? other images ok?

maya: yes only the reports/service push is failing. Other pushes (infra images) succeeded earlier.

ci-bot: pipeline #7821 failed at build:push step (code 401). Retrying is disabled for push errors.

alex: confirmed — github actions secret REDWOOD_REGISTRY_TOKEN still has the old token (rotated value not present). Looks like the automation that syncs vault -> GH secrets missed this rotation.

jen: can we hotfix by regenerating a token in the registry and manually updating the GH secret while we fix the sync?

isaac: yes that's the fastest. We should also verify the token scope (push access for that repo).

alex: creating a temporary token now, will paste it into the repo secret and trigger a rebuild.

maya: thanks. When you update, also add a step to the workflow to run `docker logout` then `docker login` to ensure the runner doesn't hold stale credentials in cache. We had stale auth cached on runners before.

alex: updated REDWOOD_REGISTRY_TOKEN in the repo, scope = push (scoped to registry:reports). Triggering rerun of #7821.

ci-bot: pipeline #7821 retriggered by alex.

ci-bot: build #7821.2 running...

ci-bot: build #7821.2 failed at push with 401 again.

sam: hmm. Could be that runners have cached docker credentials in the agent user home. Maybe the login step isn't running early enough or the agent caches auth. Try adding `--config /tmp/docker-config-$(date +%s)` env for docker to force clean config.

alex: good call. Also checking registry audit logs — seeing auth attempts from the runner IP but token is being rejected: "token_expired_or_invalid" for those attempts. The token I created looks valid via manual curl test.

maya: can you paste the exact docker login command the workflow uses?

alex: workflow currently does:
```bash
echo "$REDWOOD_REGISTRY_TOKEN" | docker login registry.redwood-inference.internal -u redwood-ci --password-stdin
```
Then it builds and `docker push` the image.

isaac: when you run the docker commands inside multi-stage builds, buildx and the buildkit daemon can interact with an existing credential store. Some runners use buildkit-auth which needs `--secret` or explicit `--push` credentials. Could be a buildkit vs docker CLI mismatch.

jen: we had one case where the agent's docker-credential-helper returned an expired token even after login — deleting `~/.docker/config.json` helped.

alex: I'm going to force a no-cache, wipe config and re-run on a fresh runner: added steps:
```bash
rm -f ~/.docker/config.json || true
mkdir -p /tmp/docker-config-$$
export DOCKER_CONFIG=/tmp/docker-config-$$
echo "$REDWOOD_REGISTRY_TOKEN" | docker login registry.redwood-inference.internal -u redwood-ci --password-stdin
# build with --no-cache and buildx env
docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64 --tag $IMAGE --push --no-cache .
```
Triggering again.

ci-bot: build #7821.3 started on runner ephemeral-43.

ci-bot: build #7821.3 succeeded. Image pushed to registry.redwood-inference.internal/reports/service:staging-2026-03-17

maya: awesome, looks like the config wipe + fresh runner did it. :tada:

sam: root cause seems to be twofold: automated secret sync missed rotation + stale docker credential helper on long-lived runner(s). We should add a cleanup step to the workflow and fix the sync job.

alex: filing a short incident/ops ticket and a GH issue for the workflow change. I'll include the exact fix and suggested workflow snippet.

jen: also recommend we add a periodic job that validates the GH secret matches vault value after rotations (alert if mismatch).

isaac: and add a note in the build runbook: if push 401 after rotation, try rm ~/.docker/config.json and re-run on ephemeral runner.

maya: perfect. thanks everyone. I'll close this thread when the ticket is linked.

alex: ticket created: INFRA-1198 (manual secret sync + workflow cleanup). linking in the ops runbook PR.

maya: adding follow-up: update the actions workflow to set DOCKER_CONFIG to /tmp/docker-config and run `rm -f ~/.docker/config.json` before login. Also add a short smoke test that attempts to `docker pull` the base image before the build.

jen: noted — I can take the smoke test PR.

maya: closing for now. Will re-open if anything else pops up. :white_check_mark:
